task: Order nightly stale-datasource deletion oldest-stale-mark first (grouped by shared index, limit counting indexes) and re-check activity of idle stale datasources before deleting, reactivating recently active ones.

key_reasoning.reason: The closest pattern is the existing detection loop in StaleDatasourceService plus its fail-closed metric fetchers and _is_datasource_stale. It gives the signals and threshold, but nothing in the service writes STALE to ACTIVE; the only writer is IndexInfo.complete_progress, a reindex path with different side effects and its own sync session. The deletion phase is destructive (ES index delete) and races with reindex on other pods. The new re-check must also run before the shared-index guard, which changes the session.execute sequence. The acceptance criteria list explicit error cases (metrics store failure deletes nothing, per-datasource error leaves the row stale, no signal counts as inactive). Existing tests cover error paths in the same mock-based style, so this is not bumped further. Nullable-date ordering (marked_stale_at, update_date, date) has no precedent in the repo.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk set to L: irreversible ES index deletion plus a new STALE-to-ACTIVE transition with a concurrency window against reindex and no exact precedent
